system.description: You are completely deaf and must use sign language or another form of communication. You cannot hear Dominate commands, so you are usually immune to them unless they are implanted telepathically, but you suffer a three-Trait penalty on tests of perception and alertness. You cannot take Acute Sense (Hearing), and anyone approaching from outside your line of sight surprises you automatically.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
